column2: (4)  An employer in any industry or service who had made

increases  added  together  exceed  the  amount  to  be  increased
under  subsection  (1)  or  under  subsections  (1)  and  (2),  such

column2: (5) A worker who has received wages or salary increase of a

entitled to an allowance under subsection (1) which is equivalent
to  the  difference  between  one  thousand  five  hundred  rupees
and the amount of such wages or salary increase.

column2: (6) A worker who has received wages or salary increase of a

column1: sum more than one thousand five hundred rupees and less than

allowance  under  subsection  (2)  which  is  equivalent  to  the
